fieldOrder.title: Take order
fieldOrder.notMine: This customer is not on your list.
fieldOrder.blocked: The customer is at or over the credit limit. A credit order goes to the office for approval; cash or advance is not held.
fieldOrder.hiddenItems: The server checks the full account; some items are not shown in the app.
fieldOrder.noPriceList: No price list is set for this customer. The office sets it on Route sales; until then orders cannot be taken here.
fieldOrder.emptyList: The customer's price list has no items yet.
fieldOrder.badQty: Quantities are whole numbers or up to 3 decimals.
fieldOrder.serverNote: Prices come from the price list. GST, totals and the credit check are done by the server; offline the order is kept on the phone and confirmed when sent.

result.confirmed: Order {{doc}} confirmed. The customer gets the confirmation on WhatsApp.
result.pending_credit: Order {{doc}} is over the credit limit and waits for the office's approval.

fieldOrder.queued: Order saved on this phone · it is confirmed when sent; prices and GST are final then.
